findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: update_invite, request_approval, find, search_people, get_person, request_appointment · Private data: remember, request_approval, search_people, get_person, create_profile_draft, request_appointment · Public sink: create_invite, request_approval, book, get_person, create_profile_draft, request_appointment · Destructive: delete_qr_code, remember, forget, delete_invite.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: update_invite, request_approval, find, search_people, get_person, request_appointment · Private data: remember, request_approval, search_people, get_person, create_profile_draft, request_appointment · Public sink: create_invite, request_approval, book, get_person, create_profile_draft, request_appointment · Destructive: delete_qr_code, remember, forget, delete_invite

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
